reading_note: The teaching describes the threefold descent of Divine Truth into the natural mind to rescue what has been captured by self-love: (1) the First Man — the original sending of Divine Truth that gives itself up so the seeds of spiritual life (the "sons" / Living Soul) can be planted in the realm of falsity; (2) the Living Spirit — the operative power that, like a craftsman, prepares the vessels and faculties (armament) and goes as warrior to draw the captive interior good out of the hands of falsities; (3) the Ambassador (Third Messenger) — the awakening call that retrieves the dispersed goods of love from their captivity. The arc: descent → loss/scattering → seeking → arming → rescue → restoration of what was taken.
